'''Scott Sichta''' (also published as '''Scott Sicha''')<ref name="dt-14881">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14881 Mega Mega  Profit], DeckTech (Scott "snoova69" Sichta, 29 March 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14881/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14881/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''snoova69''') posted a [[Light]] [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]] list on DeckTech in March 2001. He played at the [[January 2001 Geneva tournament]] on 6 January 2001 with [[Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|Agents (Harc Seff rep) with speeders]], according to Alex Helmke's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1608">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-09-geneva-illinois-01-06-00d1608/ geneva-illinois-01-06-00], DeckTech (Alex "aljex" Helmke, 9 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-09-geneva-illinois-01-06-00d1608/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
